Question: Can the platform generate realistic synthetic datasets for testing agent behaviour, edge cases, and failure modes; respecting privacy and bias considerations?
Response: Yes. Foundry provides synthetic data generation capabilities for testing agentic workflows. For POC2: 500 synthetic CVs generated for bias/accuracy testing of the screening skill. The agentic loop itself can generate synthetic test data as part of evaluation — the code interpreter sandbox produces realistic datasets following specified distributions, demographics, and edge cases. Privacy: synthetic data has no PII linkage to real individuals. Bias testing: evaluation runs compare screening outcomes across demographic dimensions to detect and measure bias. Synthetic data generation parameters are configurable and auditable.
Key Technologies: Foundry synthetic data, GHCP SDK code interpreter, Foundry Evaluators
POC Demo: POC2: Generate 500 synthetic CVs, run screening skill against them, evaluate for bias and accuracy with Foundry Evaluators.

Question: Describe evaluator agents that systematically test responses across prompt variations, adversarial inputs, and regression suites.
Response: Foundry Evaluators provide systematic evaluation across multiple dimensions: task adherence, tool call accuracy, safety, groundedness, and sensitive data exposure. Multi-prompt evaluation: (1) Prompt variation testing — run the same task with different skill configurations and prompt variations, compare quality metrics. (2) Adversarial testing — Foundry supports adversarial input generation to test agent robustness (prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, edge case inputs). (3) Regression suites — define evaluation datasets with expected outcomes, run as part of CI/CD pipeline before skill promotion. The evaluation results feed into the API Center lifecycle: a skill cannot be promoted to Production if evaluation scores fall below thresholds. Additionally, the Fleet Manager can run continuous evaluation on production traffic — comparing live agent outputs against quality baselines.
Key Technologies: Foundry Evaluators, API Center lifecycle gates, Fleet Manager continuous evaluation, CI/CD integration
POC Demo: POC2: Show multi-prompt evaluation of screening skill — variation testing across prompt configurations with quality comparison dashboard.

Question: Describe ongoing monitoring of agent performance against baselines with automated alerts when quality, accuracy, or behaviour drifts beyond thresholds.
Response: Three-layer drift detection. (1) Foundry Evaluators: run continuous evaluation on production traffic. Task Adherence evaluator detects when an agent drifts from its defined purpose. Quality scores are tracked against baselines. Automated alerts when scores drop below configurable thresholds. (2) APIM AI Gateway: monitors per-model, per-agent metrics (latency, error rate, token usage, cost). Statistical anomaly detection triggers alerts for unusual patterns. (3) Fleet Manager agent: reasons about fleet-wide quality trends by consuming evaluation results and APIM metrics. Detects emerging patterns (e.g. screening accuracy declining for a specific job category) and surfaces proactive alerts on the Control Plane with recommended actions (investigate root cause, revert skill version, increase HITL oversight). All alerts flow through Azure Monitor with configurable notification channels.
Key Technologies: Foundry Evaluators (continuous), APIM anomaly detection, Fleet Manager trend analysis, Azure Monitor alerts
POC Demo: POC2: Show drift detection — screening accuracy drops for engineering roles, Fleet Manager alerts HR BP with root cause analysis and recommendations.

Question: Do you provide sandboxed simulation environments where agents can be tested against realistic scenarios at scale before production deployment?
Response: Yes. The dev/staging/production lifecycle provides sandboxed environments at each stage. Staging environment: full simulation with mock APIs (WPP provides sandbox APIs for Workday, D365, Greenhouse) running real agentic loops against realistic scenarios. Foundry supports separate projects per environment with isolated configurations. API Center lifecycle gates ensure skills are tested in staging before production promotion. For scale simulation: Durable Functions can run hundreds of concurrent simulated workflows in the staging environment. Synthetic data generation (500 CVs, synthetic invoices) provides realistic test data. Foundry Evaluators run comprehensive evaluation suites against the staging deployment. The staging environment mirrors production configuration (APIM policies, Foundry Guardrails, skill versions) with sandbox integrations instead of live systems.
Key Technologies: Foundry staging projects, API Center lifecycle, Durable Functions (scale simulation), sandbox APIs
POC Demo: POC2: Show staging environment with 500 synthetic CVs processed through the full screening pipeline, evaluated for quality before production deployment.
